steps.name: An Infected Knight
steps.text: Topple the Chamber! Topple the nobles! Death to Olmer Ingra!

steps.name: An Infected Knight
steps.text: Topple the Chamber! Topple the nobles! Death to Olmer Ingra!

steps.name: Justyna
steps.text: Wrath is spreading between us.

steps.name: Justyna
steps.text: I get it, but...

steps.name: Sona
steps.text: Wrath. We're all used to that state of mind.

steps.name: Sona
steps.text: But it makes a person short-sighted. We've already suffered for it.

steps.name: Iwona
steps.text: Hah. Keeping a clear head sure ain't my style.

steps.name: Sona
steps.text: You don't need to keep it, just charge ahead with it, that's all.

steps.name: Iwona
steps.text: I can roll with that. Sure, I'll leave the complicated stuff to you guys, and the fights, you leave to me.

steps.name: Iwona
steps.text: I've been holding this in forever, Sona.

steps.name: Sona
steps.text: I know.

steps.name: Sona
steps.text: Before Szewczyk and Ashley come back, we need to find people who were there... reporters work, heck, eyewitnesses work. The more, the better.

steps.name: Justyna
steps.text: ...The Great Kawalerielki Separation.

steps.name: Justyna
steps.text: External reports said it was an industrial accident caused by damage from Leithanian extremists, to shatter the smooth running of the Major.

steps.name: Sona
steps.text: No city comes that weak. More than likely it was everyone dragging each other down.

steps.name: Sona
steps.text: But what's clear is the whole shake-up showed people just where Kawalerielki... this 'City of Greatness' was rotting through.

steps.name: Greynuty
steps.text: Never mind me, you're sort of a famous knight too, aren't you? Won't strutting around like this get you recognized?

steps.name: Plastic Knight
steps.text: Who'd care about a nobody like me while the Major's on?

steps.name: Plastic Knight
steps.text: Why are you the one going with me? I thought it'd be that sniper. She's a better fit with this sort of thing.

steps.name: Greynuty
steps.text: Justyna? She's more liable to get exposed than I am, actually, not to mention she's already the one who dared to rescue you.

steps.name: Greynuty
steps.text: No need to keep dangerous elements together, and you're both bow knights. If you did get attacked in the streets, it'd be tough to handle.

steps.name: Plastic Knight
steps.text: Isn't that nice. No, you just wanted to keep an eye on me, didn't you?

steps.name: Greynuty
steps.text: Hmph.

steps.name: Greynuty
steps.text: A knight-noble wouldn't make peace with the Infected, even if he clashed with the Armorless. Do you really think I'd let my guard down around you?

steps.name: Plastic Knight
steps.text: Rubbish. I worry I'll get infected, and I worry my family will. What's wrong with that?

steps.name: Plastic Knight
steps.text: Don't think you're my lone disbeliever, Ashlock Knight.

steps.name: Greynuty
steps.text: Really? Then now seems like your best chance to escape, Plastic Knight.

steps.name: Greynuty
steps.text: So long as—

steps.name: Plastic Knight
steps.text: —You shut up, you petulant brat.

steps.name: Plastic Knight
steps.text: I didn't come to play rise of the weak with you. I don't give a damn about your demands, or whether you need your trust in each other to live—

steps.name: Plastic Knight
steps.text: —I only came to hunt those audacious bastards down. I guarantee the Armorless will give me hell, and they'll put my family through worse doing it, so I'm making the first damned move.

steps.name: Plastic Knight
steps.text: That's why I'm here now. My wife, my child, and no one else. Believe me, I don't have the slightest concern for your ridiculous cause.

steps.name: Plastic Knight
steps.text: Don't get so full of yourself, Infected. You think the only thing that makes up this city is 'your enemies' and 'your friends?' What a model victim complex...

steps.name: Plastic Knight
steps.text: Let me tell you, in Kazimierz, in this society of ours, the majority are 'not concerned with you at all.'

steps.name: Greynuty
steps.text: It's quiet around here.

steps.name: Plastic Knight
steps.text: This is the General Chamber's ground floor. Only nomadic city engineers and maintenance crew are allowed into the structuring below us. We'll have to stop here.

steps.name: Plastic Knight
steps.text: Hmph.

steps.name: Plastic Knight
steps.text: Relax, no need to be so cautious. No cameras here.

steps.name: Greynuty
steps.text: But can you guarantee there's no Armorless?

steps.name: Plastic Knight
steps.text: Hilarious. The Armorless wouldn't choose a public venue—especially not a hub of the elite like this to start killing.

steps.name: Plastic Knight
steps.text: It'd give the Adeptus Sprawiedliwi too much of a hold on them. That's where they draw the line, and we're going to toe that line for all it's worth.

steps.name: Plastic Knight
steps.text: Realistically, how many knights does Kazimierz have? They've got nothing but ID-type fodder to judge who's who... it's child's play to disguise.

steps.name: Greynuty
steps.text: So what is your family going to do?

steps.name: Plastic Knight
steps.text: Aside from my missing wife and child, they've been sent out of Kawalerielki already.

steps.name: Greynuty
steps.text: The Armorless Union has its informants far beyond where Kawalerielki ends.

steps.name: Plastic Knight
steps.text: I know that.

steps.name: Plastic Knight
steps.text: Maybe if I get another chance, I'll cut back on the recklessness. At least until my child grows up, and can take care of himself.

steps.name: Plastic Knight
steps.text: But the K.G.C.C. don't sell remedies for regret. This is where we are, Infected, so we'd better put the complaining to rest.

steps.name: A Corporate Employee
steps.text: Huff... dammit, the supermarkets and restaurants are all shut. Why did they set a meeting for this time.

steps.name: A Corporate Employee
steps.text: *Sigh*... If I revise the draft early morning, maybe they won't chew me out so hard in editing—

steps.name: A Corporate Employee
steps.text: —Huh?

steps.name: Sona
steps.text: Sorry to bother you. You must be pretty beat after a long day of work, huh, Mister Reporter?

steps.name: A Corporate Employee
steps.text: A... A knight? Where did you come from?!

steps.name: Sona
steps.text: Easy now, sir.

steps.name: Sona
steps.text: Want a sandwich?

steps.name: A Corporate Employee
steps.text: H—Huh?!

steps.name: Sona
steps.text: C'mon. I'm asking because you look like someone dragged you through a car wash.

steps.name: A Corporate Employee
steps.text: Please leave immediately, or I'll sound the alarm! Even if you're a knight, this is...

steps.name: A Corporate Employee
steps.text: Eep?

steps.name: Sona
steps.text: Your phone lines are cut.

steps.name: Sona
steps.text: Here's the deal. Both your neighbors are out far away, and right now, my partners in crime are pretending to be renovation workers, carrying out rush repairs on this building's elevator and entrance.

steps.name: A Corporate Employee
steps.text: Wh... What the hell are you trying to do? I don't have any money, I don't know anything...

steps.name: Sona
steps.text: Easy, there, wind it down. You make me out like I'm a robber here.

steps.name: Sona
steps.text: You. There was a report on the 'Great Kawalerielki Separation' a few years back. You wrote that, right?

steps.name: A Corporate Employee
steps.text: M... Me?

steps.name: A Corporate Employee
steps.text: With an incident that huge, every outlet in the whole country would be reporting on it. There's no way I didn't write something...

steps.name: A Corporate Employee
steps.text: B—But, I'm just a net editor... I was still working at The Illuminator then, and by now that whole paper's been bought out.

steps.name: Sona
steps.text: Mm-hm, I know, which is why you only need to answer a couple questions for us, and then we're gone. Sound good?

steps.name: Sona
steps.text: We just want to get an idea of the situation. And we got you supper on the side.

steps.name: A Corporate Employee
steps.text: (Err... is she actually carrying a bag of sandwiches?)

steps.name: Sona
steps.text: You had an interview in your report with a pretty unassuming janitor, who said 'I thought there was an earthquake, and I climbed out of the transport pipes, I was so desperate.'

steps.name: Sona
steps.text: Looking at the picture, this is the General Chamber of Commerce Tower, right? During the Great Separation, the electricals were all out, but the Chamber has a standalone power source.

steps.name: Sona
steps.text: Can you give me some details about what you... saw of things?

steps.name: An Armorless Union Member
steps.text: Reporting in, 'Lazurite' Monique.

steps.name: An Armorless Union Member
steps.text: We have traces of movement from a few targets here. They've split up to investigate something. And the Kuranta 'Wild Mane' Iwona Krukowska is nearby guarding the Infected.

steps.name: Monique
steps.text: They've set up an Infected community.

steps.name: Monique
steps.text: But they're still hoping their own strength, their own violence will protect it from falling apart?

steps.name: Monique
steps.text: Is this how stupid knights have gotten these days?

steps.name: An Armorless Union Member
steps.text: Right. Here's their list of contacts... and some calls we've intercepted from them.

steps.name: An Armorless Union Member
steps.text: They're very cunning, steering clear of wireless communication. There's a good chance these messages are all a smokescreen.

steps.name: Monique
steps.text: Forget anything else, they're investigating the 'Great Kawalerielki Separation.'

steps.name: An Armorless Union Member
steps.text: Er... how do you...

steps.name: Monique
steps.text: If your deductions are as convoluted next time, either you're dead, or you're out of a job. Learn a thing or two.

steps.name: An Armorless Union Member
steps.text: R—Right! Please give your instructions!

steps.name: Monique
steps.text: (Exasperated sigh) With Wild Mane Knight left alone, what instructions could you even need?

steps.name: An Armorless Union Member
steps.text: S—Sorry, I'll go give the order to surround—

steps.name: Monique
steps.text: If anything happens with the media or Adeptus Sprawiedliwi, will your heads on the chopping block even make up for it?

steps.name: An Armorless Union Member
steps.text: I... I can't...

steps.name: Monique
steps.text: Forget it. I'll go myself.

steps.name: An Armorless Union Member
steps.text: Y—You don't need to go to the trouble!

steps.name: Monique
steps.text: It's not right to pull off that big of a maneuver before any official orders come from up top.

steps.name: Monique
steps.text: Taking out an Infected knight's nothing difficult, but it has to be silent, no hide nor hair. Can any of you do that?

steps.name: An Armorless Union Member
steps.text: Well...

steps.name: Monique
steps.text: If you get it, then zip it, and while it's zipped, drag Roy back for me. They could've picked anyone to keep watch on the Nightzmora. Why waste a Lazurite's time on the clock?

steps.name: Monique
steps.text: Seriously...

steps.name: Monique
steps.text: Target, confirmed. Wild Mane Knight, Iwona Krukowska.

steps.name: Monique
steps.text: Date, weather, present state of mind... but this isn't an official assignment. I shouldn't need to record so much detail.

steps.name: Monique
steps.text: Hmm. And no need to kill too many Infected. It'll be terrible on the million-to-one I get infected myself.

steps.name: Monique
steps.text: Anyway...

steps.name: Iwona
steps.text: Huh, wonder what that sweet smell's about.

steps.name: Iwona
steps.text: Flowers? Who's planting flowers here?

steps.name: 'Justice Knight'
steps.text: (Relaxed beeping noises)

steps.name: Iwona
steps.text: Whaaat?! Who knew you could do this stuff too, Justice!

steps.name: 'Justice Knight'
steps.text: (Hurried beeping noises)
Swoosh.
Loosing a rubber arrow, Justice Knight knocks over the plastic water bottle beside it, fresh water hydrating the flowerpot in front of them.

steps.name: 'Justice Knight'
steps.text: (Loud beeping noises)

steps.name: Iwona
steps.text: Justice! You're amazing! Did you learn to do this yourself?!

steps.name: 'Justice Knight'
steps.text: (Loud beeping noises)

steps.name: Iwona
steps.text: —What?!

steps.name: Iwona
steps.text: Whoa, watch out! The wall's come down!

steps.name: 'Justice Knight'
steps.text: (Hurried beeping noises)

steps.name: Iwona
steps.text: No questions! Move!

steps.name: 'Justice Knight'
steps.text: (Hurried beeping noises)

steps.name: Iwona
steps.text: Tch—

steps.name: Monique
steps.text: (Couldn't confirm my position, so she immediately began vacating. Solid intuition.)

steps.name: Monique
steps.text: (But... this is too slow of a pace.)

steps.name: Monique
steps.text: I'll be seeing you.

steps.name: A Gofer Armorless Union Member
steps.text: So we just come back like this? And, uh, the Union shouldn't be randomly waltzing into the General Chamber's building, should it?

steps.name: A Seasoned Armorless Union Member
steps.text: *Sigh* Of course we can't, logically.

steps.name: A Seasoned Armorless Union Member
steps.text: But you can't ignore a Lazurite's orders... ugh, I didn't have a boss this annoying back when I was a merc.

steps.name: A Gofer Armorless Union Member
steps.text: Won't it be a little... unsafe, leaving Monique alone in the Infected ghetto?

steps.name: A Seasoned Armorless Union Member
steps.text: Ha, you're worrying about her? What, us? Worried about a Lazurite?

steps.name: A Gofer Armorless Union Member
steps.text: Well... the Lazurites are people too, and she looks pretty young...

steps.name: A Seasoned Armorless Union Member
steps.text: *Sigh*... You've never seen the Lazurites get serious first-hand? You'll wanna make sure to prepare yourself, then.

steps.name: A Seasoned Armorless Union Member
steps.text: Have you heard how it goes? 'Platinum' needs to be someone with the leadership to guide a team, the brains to plan out the big picture in the most involved operations.

steps.name: A Seasoned Armorless Union Member
steps.text: As for the 'Lazurites'... they say the ones of the past, whether one or two... were all chosen because they could 'kill any one target in Kazimierz.'

steps.name: A Gofer Armorless Union Member
steps.text: Uh... you're kidding, right? Any? Including all those campaign knights?

steps.name: A Seasoned Armorless Union Member
steps.text: Well, that's lost to history... I'm not sure if it's true or not. They say even a few campaign knight leaders were—

steps.name: Roy
steps.text: Oh, hey, what's got you two so excited?

steps.name: A Gofer Armorless Union Member
steps.text: Erk...

steps.name: A Seasoned Armorless Union Member
steps.text: R-Roy, sir!

steps.name: Roy
steps.text: You know something? People will suspect the Armorless Union, showing up publicly at the K.G.C.C.

steps.name: Roy
steps.text: It might be comedy to you, but you guys should take a guess. There's a reason they don't let the Union wander in and out of here... why?

steps.name: A Gofer Armorless Union Member
steps.text: (Shudder) I—It... it's not like that...

steps.name: A Seasoned Armorless Union Member
steps.text: Sir, this is a misunderstanding. Monique wanted us here to notify you. Otherwise, we would never—

steps.name: Roy
steps.text: Ahahaha, why so tense? What, you scared I'm gonna eat you?

steps.name: A Seasoned Armorless Union Member
steps.text: As... long as you understand. Monique's carrying something out in the Infected ghettos, and she wanted us to inform you.

steps.name: Roy
steps.text: Infected, huh.

steps.name: Roy
steps.text: Alright, got it. Thanks for the notice.

steps.name: Roy
steps.text: Now get out of here quick, it smells of sterilizer everywhere. Hm, but the coffee downstairs is pretty good. You can steal a cup before you go.

steps.name: Roy
steps.text: See you. Hope you have fun with work~

steps.name: A Seasoned Armorless Union Member
steps.text: Phew.

steps.name: A Gofer Armorless Union Member
steps.text: ...Ulk... *cough* *cough*... urp...

steps.name: A Seasoned Armorless Union Member
steps.text: Where's the bathroom... *sigh* I told you to prepare yourself.

steps.name: A Seasoned Armorless Union Member
steps.text: I'm lucky enough I was a merc, but most others who switch jobs to join us are in for a little roughness. Just ride it out.

steps.name: A Gofer Armorless Union Member
steps.text: Urgh... hah, hah... am I still alive?

steps.name: A Seasoned Armorless Union Member
steps.text: You are, you are. Now you get it, don't you? We shouldn't get mixed up with their work.

steps.name: A Seasoned Armorless Union Member
steps.text: And Monique wouldn't mess up.

steps.name: Iwona
steps.text: (Another wide shot? What's the deal?)

steps.name: Iwona
steps.text: (But this force—I still can't clock the position—is the enemy messing with me?!)

steps.name: Iwona
steps.text: Dammit—

steps.name: Iwona
steps.text: Is this all I can do?! Run?!

steps.name: Monique
steps.text: Missed... grr.

steps.name: Monique
steps.text: You...

steps.name: Toland
steps.text: Hey, miss, don't give me that look. I just wanted to ask you about something.

steps.name: Toland
steps.text: Am I disturbing you? If you're not up to answer, I'll go on my way.

steps.name: Monique
steps.text: What is it?

steps.name: Toland
steps.text: Ah, thank you. Actually, I'm looking for someone—

steps.name: Toland
steps.text: —'Lazurite' Monique. It's a pseudonym, of course. Heard of her, if you don't mind me asking?

steps.name: Monique
steps.text: As it happens, I'm looking for someone too.

steps.name: Toland
steps.text: Oh? Sorry to confess, I'm fresh on the boat here. Can't say I recognize all that many heads or tails yet.

steps.name: Monique
steps.text: That's alright, he's a plenty infamous bounty hunter. Seeing him once would be enough to remember.

steps.name: Toland
steps.text: Hoo. Go on, do tell?

steps.name: Monique
steps.text: The 'Guildmaster', Toland Cash.

steps.name: Monique
steps.text: Thirteen counts of murder, eight of robbery, twenty-three of disturbing the peace, six of illegal Originium dealing... and to top it off—conspiracy, on one count.

steps.name: Monique
steps.text: Also, most importantly, he's gotten in the way of my work... twice, now.

steps.name: Monique
steps.text: I hate people who get in the way of my work. Despise them.

steps.name: Toland
steps.text: Well, well... Say, ever think you've gotten the wrong idea about him?

steps.name: Monique
steps.text: All of us turn a blind eye to the bounty hunters' influence by default... but they shouldn't have organized, let alone grown large-scale.

steps.name: Toland
steps.text: That's not fair to say. With 'Flamelung' and 'Yellow Smog' suddenly AWOL—poor brothers—that big of a territory without any boss, of course there's gotta be an organization. Work needs it to go smooth.

steps.name: Toland
steps.text: Go ahead. Calls always come at the worst times, don't they?

steps.name: Monique
steps.text: It's me. I'm working.

steps.name: Monique
steps.text: ...Got it.

steps.name: Toland
steps.text: It seems you're leaving. What an awful shame.

steps.name: Toland
steps.text: Tell Miss Monique I said hi.

steps.name: Monique
steps.text: Likewise, then. Tell Toland this for me.

steps.name: Monique
steps.text: Tell him—

steps.name: Monique
steps.text: —That slippery little clown face of yours spoils my appetite.

steps.name: Toland
steps.text: We really had a close shave there, Kuranta.

steps.name: Toland
steps.text: She might not catch up to me, but I'm sure she'd win the fight.

steps.name: Iwona
steps.text: Who... the hell are you?

steps.name: Toland
steps.text: I'll introduce myself again. Toland Cash, just a bounty hunter.

steps.name: Toland
steps.text: I come in good faith—that's my real name, you know. My old daddy gave it to me before he drank himself to the other side. True story.

steps.name: Iwona
steps.text: Bounty guy, just now, that was the Armorless Union's...

steps.name: Toland
steps.text: The Armorless Union's Lazurite. Put away any funny ideas of chasing her—you'd all be done for then.

steps.name: Toland
steps.text: But if even the Lazurite's showing up to this party, that means I'm in the right place.

steps.name: Iwona
steps.text: You're mad off the mark if you want treasure. Only the Infected, homeless and penniless living out the days here.

steps.name: Iwona
steps.text: What are you here looking for? Huh, bounty hunter?

steps.name: Toland
steps.text: The will to rebel.

steps.name: Toland
steps.text: I came on this informant's info, see... heard you guys were planning something real extraordinary.

steps.name: Toland
steps.text: I don't want you to jump the gun, now. There's no traitors in your gang, and I can tell you they didn't have the loose lips to blab to me.

steps.name: Toland
steps.text: But when the city moves forward, it sucks everyone into the wake. You can't just make believe it's only 'heroes' and 'villains' in the Grand Knight Territory, right?

steps.name: Iwona
steps.text: I'm not Sona. I'm not all good at chewing this stuff over.

steps.name: Iwona
steps.text: But seeing how you just saved my life, I guess I can show you to someone or other.

steps.name: Toland
steps.text: Now THAT'S what I call lifesaving.

steps.name: 'Justice Knight'
steps.text: (Slow beeping noises)

steps.name: Toland
steps.text: Oh? What's this? A takeout cart?

steps.name: Iwona
steps.text: Takeout, my ass! This is my pet! My pride and joy! You watch what you say!

steps.name: Toland
steps.text: Hah, knights really have gotten interesting.

steps.name: Monique
steps.text: I suddenly understand why I hate seeing Toland Cash so much.

steps.name: Roy
steps.text: Why's that?

steps.name: Monique
steps.text: Because he's too much like you.

steps.name: Roy
steps.text: *cough*... Are you calling me out?

steps.name: Monique
steps.text: Get on with it. What did you interrupt me for?

steps.name: Roy
steps.text: You've been too hard at it lately. Isn't it nice, relaxing every once in a while?

steps.name: Monique
steps.text: I'm heading back to work.

steps.name: Roy
steps.text: No, nuh-uh, you've been getting more and more workaholic lately.

steps.name: Roy
steps.text: See, the curtain's pulled open on the Radiant Knight's Major adventure, and I'm not exactly resting easy with just Platinum on the case.

steps.name: Roy
steps.text: And the Adeptus Sprawiedliwi has been scarily quiet this year. Usually they'd be firing opening shots against the Board of Directors by now, what with all their documents and meetings.

steps.name: Monique
steps.text: And this is your grounds for shirking work?

steps.name: Roy
steps.text: Not entirely. The 'three above' are having us keep this in check lately.

steps.name: Monique
steps.text: Hmm.

steps.name: Roy
steps.text: To be strict about it, the Infected are creating an opportunity for us.

steps.name: Roy
steps.text: Darksteel'll seize that to eliminate the last of those who know what really happened, and shift the blame to the Infected.

steps.name: Roy
steps.text: What we should be doing now isn't harming the Infected. When it comes to it, in fact, we even ought to give them a little help from the shadows.

steps.name: Roy
steps.text: But we can't be too obvious about this, so I let you enjoy the hassle of finding them, seeing it through to the end.

steps.name: Monique
steps.text: Work really does shift under your feet when it wants.

steps.name: Roy
steps.text: We're on the Board of Directors's dime, after all. All we can do is be their people.

steps.name: Roy
steps.text: Provisionally, of course.

steps.name: Monique
steps.text: Heh.

steps.name: Monique
steps.text: How's the Nightzmora business going?

steps.name: Roy
steps.text: Not much to be concerned with, just a moron tracing the footsteps of old-timey legends.

steps.name: Roy
steps.text: We'll fix up a match for him to face one of the Grand Knights later. After the 'Nightzmora reenactment' thing gets enough buzz, it can get dumped.

steps.name: Roy
steps.text: That's 'knights' for you, after all. A Nightzmora orphan living in the present day—it's gotta be hard on the soul.

steps.name: Nightmare Knight
steps.text: Batbayar, what are you following me for?

steps.name: Old Knight
steps.text: You can drop that tone with me like you're on your victory lap. There's youth in your voice. Odds are you're younger than me.

steps.name: Old Knight
steps.text: Are you always so... aimless?

steps.name: Old Knight
steps.text: Don't you have anywhere to go? A titled Major knight being a tramp in Kawalerielki, really?

steps.name: Nightmare Knight
steps.text: Cities disgust me.

steps.name: Nightmare Knight
steps.text: Walking helps clear the mind. Kurantas always walk the grasslands.

steps.name: Old Knight
steps.text: It ain't no grassland here.

steps.name: Nightmare Knight
steps.text: It should be.

steps.name: Old Knight
steps.text: And you just go on like this?

steps.name: Old Knight
steps.text: How long has it been?

steps.name: Nightmare Knight
steps.text: Ten years or so. Or however many. I can't even remember now.

steps.name: Old Knight
steps.text: Er... but you did get a lift to reach Kawalerielki, right?

steps.name: Old Knight
steps.text: You crossed Kazimierz on foot?!

steps.name: Old Knight
steps.text: R—Rubbish. You've really never 'stopped' before? Don't you even need to rest?

steps.name: Nightmare Knight
steps.text: Batbayar, do you know of the 'Khaganquest?'

steps.name: Old Knight
steps.text: ...What...

steps.name: Nightmare Knight
steps.text: It was once... the apotheosis of a Kuranta's glory.

steps.name: Nightmare Knight
steps.text: At the time a warrior comes of age, in order to manifest their glory as a Kuranta, in the company of their mother and father, they would make a promise.

steps.name: Nightmare Knight
steps.text: From the place they were born, they would leave for a distant site of trial. Taking only a weapon gifted by their parents, they would go on foot.

steps.name: Old Knight
steps.text: A site of trial...?

steps.name: Nightmare Knight
steps.text: The site of trial is decided by themselves. True courage must be recognized by themselves.

steps.name: Nightmare Knight
steps.text: The way of the courageous spans a thousand folds of the earth, while the cowardly only dared choose the forests before their own door.

steps.name: Nightmare Knight
steps.text: A distance or lack of it was by no means the sole judge. Some brave brought back the heads of prey; some brave cut off their enemies' ears; some brave were empty-handed, but bountiful with pure gold and spices.

steps.name: Nightmare Knight
steps.text: Our forebears never once forgot this tradition. This was proof of valor. Countless Nightzmora soldiers walked the Khaganquest, as the start of their long journey.

steps.name: Old Knight
steps.text: So, right now, you're... you're completing your rite of adulthood alone?

steps.name: Old Knight
steps.text: Where's your parents?

steps.name: Nightmare Knight
steps.text: Since I can recall, I had no one at all.

steps.name: Nightmare Knight
steps.text: Batbayar, I'm not ashamed to admit. To be with you, one of the same blood, no matter how distant, consoles me somewhat.

steps.name: Nightmare Knight
steps.text: At least, it lets me take in that, in this age twistedly proceeding, my past brethren... are still alive.

steps.name: Old Knight
steps.text: Alright... Are you gonna hang around the Grand Knight Territory like this for the time being, then?

steps.name: Nightmare Knight
steps.text: Kawalerielki... I learned from the travelers, this place is the center of the land of the knights, Kazimierz's glory.

steps.name: Nightmare Knight
steps.text: Yet now I see, it's no more than a rotting fort, trampling the glory, the honor that should shine esteemed.

steps.name: Nightmare Knight
steps.text: Once, my brethren were trialed in their Khaganquests by beast and Catastrophe. And what I face now, is a forward-roaring, grassland-crushing metal titan.

a.text: They're the pinnacles of modern Kazimierzian knighthood, the strong that garner all attention.
Dwelling on their image amounts to nothing. Attempting to debate the attitude of the knight of now comes off as utterly foolish.
Only through one victory after another can it be understood, just how Kazimierz postures itself in the modern day.

steps.name: Nightmare Knight
steps.text: It happens to block my Khaganquest.

steps.name: Nightmare Knight
steps.text: So I will conquer it, in order to prove my fatedness.

steps.name: Spokesman McKee
steps.text: Each knight in Kawalerielki has their own reason to fight.

steps.name: Spokesman McKee
steps.text: Maybe many of the ignorant beyond Kazimierz would criticize the modern knight competitions as 'defying tradition,' 'renouncing glory.'

steps.name: Spokesman McKee
steps.text: But we're not of that mind at all. The times are changing, industry and finance are expanding. Do you honestly still want the people putting stock in the traditions of killing? Rampant duels paid with blood, in modern society?

steps.name: Spokesman McKee
steps.text: No, the General Chamber of Commerce finds it very hard to sanction such things.

steps.name: Candle Knight
steps.text: Cities springing up, engines rumbling as they turn.

steps.name: Candle Knight
steps.text: This is an age of rapid progress. Yes, wildly unlike it was over a decade ago, Mr. McKee.

steps.name: Spokesman McKee
steps.text: Madam Droste. The General Chamber expects your certain victory.

steps.name: Spokesman McKee
steps.text: The Infected knight crisis is intensifying. Taken as a locus, the Radiant Knight will extol it, and the Board of Directors will lose great face over it.

steps.name: Candle Knight
steps.text: I understand.

steps.name: Spokesman McKee
steps.text: I... *sigh* I don't mean to trouble you—I'm guessing you still won't accept our proposals, will you?

steps.name: Spokesman McKee
steps.text: But I hope you'll realize, you won't actually need to do anything.

steps.name: Candle Knight
steps.text: McKee.

steps.name: Candle Knight
steps.text: I want to decide a victor between me and the Radiant Knight, fair and square.

steps.name: Candle Knight
steps.text: 'I won't need to do anything.' These last few years, I've always been solicited as such.

steps.name: Candle Knight
steps.text: Mr. McKee, as a knight, inaction itself is one brand of action. Can you sympathize with that?

steps.name: Candle Knight
steps.text: Am I not even allowed the satisfaction of a single request anymore? Mr. McKee?

steps.name: Spokesman McKee
steps.text: No... if you really are so determined... I'll try and talk over the Knights Association and the other spokesmen.

steps.name: Spokesman McKee
steps.text: But... can you tell me why? You have no preexisting relationship with the Radiant Knight, as far as we know... What makes you so insistent?

steps.name: Candle Knight
steps.text: Why is the General Chamber so focused on her?

steps.name: Candle Knight
steps.text: Though she's of a famous family, she is no more than a knight once banished, in the end.

steps.name: Candle Knight
steps.text: Tell me, just what is the K.G.C.C. so focused on?

steps.name: Spokesman McKee
steps.text: This isn't something you and I should discuss right now, Madam Droste.

steps.name: Spokesman McKee
steps.text: But... alright. Behind this affair, it's a contest between the Adeptus Sprawiedliwi and the General Chamber.

steps.name: Spokesman McKee
steps.text: In fact, neither the K.G.C.C. nor the Adeptus ultimately care too much who 'takes the championship.'

steps.name: Spokesman McKee
steps.text: Do you understand? I've currently obliged with you... I respect your way of thinking, but your steadfastness is harming the K.G.C.C.'s outlook towards you.

steps.name: Candle Knight
steps.text: I'll explain to the knightclub myself.

steps.name: Spokesman McKee
steps.text: Our Leithanian visitors wouldn't want to see any mishaps befall you in the arena, either.

steps.name: Candle Knight
steps.text: Mishaps? Losing to an Infected champion, you mean?

steps.name: Candle Knight
steps.text: I've no illusions of the way they work. The Candle Knight Viviana Droste is celebrated so because she is a Leithanian.

steps.name: Candle Knight
steps.text: A Leithanian, finding success in the Kazimierz knight competitions, makes them beam.

steps.name: Candle Knight
steps.text: And since the Black Knight, it's a glory they've taken for granted. I became a substitute for the Black Knight by luck, no more.

steps.name: Candle Knight
steps.text: No more than vanity.

steps.name: Spokesman McKee
steps.text: It might be vain of them, yes, but their support for you is authentic. The K.G.C.C. is hoping to sign a trade agreement with the nobles at this moment, and your impact cannot be ignored.

steps.name: Candle Knight
steps.text: McKee.

steps.name: Candle Knight
steps.text: Two knights meet in a contest, hoping to fight a fair battle. Is this something so inherently forbidden?

steps.name: Spokesman McKee
steps.text: No. You're... you're right.

steps.name: Candle Knight
steps.text: Kazimierz, Leithanien. The home that birthed me.

steps.name: Candle Knight
steps.text: In childhood I imagined, that the place I lived was one where romance and glory could coexist.

steps.name: Candle Knight
steps.text: I simply want to... see, with this 'special case,' this Radiant Knight. See who comes out on top.

steps.name: Candle Knight
steps.text: At least this once, I won't need to consider how to 'win beautifully.' I only need to consider how to claim victory.

steps.name: Candle Knight
steps.text: Is that not abideable?

steps.name: Spokesman McKee
steps.text: The outcome won't change.

steps.name: Spokesman McKee
steps.text: The K.G.C.C. will find some way to force the Radiant Knight's loss. Losing to you was the most appropriate decision to make.

steps.name: Candle Knight
steps.text: You support them?

steps.name: Spokesman McKee
steps.text: In order to prevent this situation from degrading further... in order not to give the Adeptus more excuses to revolt, yes, I support this decision.

steps.name: Candle Knight
steps.text: McKee.

steps.name: Spokesman McKee
steps.text: Yes?

steps.name: Candle Knight
steps.text: I'm somewhat disappointed in you.

steps.name: Spokesman McKee
steps.text: My deepest apologies, Madam.

steps.name: Spokesman McKee
steps.text: But... I believe it is the best option...

steps.name: Spokesman McKee
steps.text: My deepest apologies.

steps.name: Candle Knight
steps.text: There's a celebration feast tonight. I'll need to be on my way soon.

steps.name: Spokesman McKee
steps.text: Right... May you travel safely.

steps.name: Candle Knight
steps.text: McKee.

steps.name: Candle Knight
steps.text: I merely, simply want to be witness in this age to a knight's radiance. True radiance.

steps.name: Candle Knight
steps.text: She's just as if a verse.

steps.name: Candle Knight
steps.text: Nothing more than that.

steps.name: Candle Knight
steps.text: Farewell.

steps.name: Spokesman McKee
steps.text: A verse, was it?

steps.name: Spokesman McKee
steps.text: Perhaps. But those poems you read... I've never once actually managed to make sense of one, Viviana.

steps.name: A Corporate Employee
steps.text: Mr. McKee? Did you order flowers? The doorman's gotten a bouquet of marigolds, and says you ordered them.

steps.name: Spokesman McKee
steps.text: Yes.

steps.name: Spokesman McKee
steps.text: It was your anniversary recently, wasn't it?

steps.name: A Corporate Employee
steps.text: Oh—uh? It was—you remembered that?

steps.name: Spokesman McKee
steps.text: It's my gift to you two. You've been a credit to your job. Don't forget to go home and spend time with your family.

steps.name: A Corporate Employee
steps.text: Wow! Mr. McKee! Thank you! Thank you so, so much!

steps.name: Spokesman McKee
steps.text: That's fine. If you've got nothing important, go on and sign off a little early.

steps.name: Spokesman McKee
steps.text: You can't live without treasuring life.
